verdict.rationale: Baseten documents OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages endpoints for Model APIs. However, nothing in the pack documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint, or any other programmatic way to list the live model catalog. OpenAI-compatible chat inference is an adjacent capability and does not establish a catalog-listing endpoint, so the applicable axis stays unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
